title: Execute fresh V15 product-quality W4A8 policy preflight

candidate_plan.role: frozen successor acceptance, lookup-repair, and authority contract

implementation_objective: Under exactly one fresh V15 construction authority, first pass the non-consuming inherited-matrix adapter-restoration regression, then build two independent deterministic full-model quantized references using all 168 sealed V10 transformer tensors and the isolated V12 64-group lm_head tensor, prove exact codec, alias, byte, and 312-event Dynamic Scale32 closure, persist those proofs before quality execution, and execute exactly the unchanged V13/V14 product-quality matrix through one immutable V15 quality campaign. Preserve raw prompts, token IDs, decoded outputs, rubric results, and honest wall times for Fresh Review. Do not modify RTL, retarget the live chat demo, access U280 tools, or use BF16 token identity as the acceptance oracle.

required_constructor.embedding: preserve the source BF16 embedding bytes and detach lm_head storage before any weight replacement
required_constructor.transformer: reconstruct exactly the sealed V10 representation for all 168 transformer Linear tensors, including four-bit payload, packed Scale24 rows, dual codebooks, per-row/block selectors, padding, and authentication
required_constructor.lm_head: reconstruct exactly the isolated V12 64 contiguous groups of 2374 rows with seven dual-bank input-block records per group and one selector bit per output row/block
required_constructor.determinism: two clean independent constructions must match all payload, metadata, state, reconstruction, tokenizer, prompt-matrix, and manifest hashes

required_self_tests: reject any plan, task, source, model, tokenizer, template, V10, V12, V13, V14 terminal, helper, diagnostic, or review-record hash mismatch before construction
prove the source embedding bytes remain unchanged and lm_head storage is not aliased to the embedding
prove all 168 transformer tensors exactly match the sealed V10 decoded representations and metadata
prove the lm_head decoded representation and metadata exactly match the isolated V12 64-group construction
round-trip every packed Scale24 record with a restored zero high byte and reject malformed or lossy encodings
round-trip every codebook, selector stream, group transition, alignment byte, and authentication record
prove exact whole-model payload, metadata, and total byte counts
prove candidate A and candidate B construction manifests are identical
run all 312 named grouped Dynamic Scale32 events with no saturation, clipping, or reserved -128 payload and no more than 832 transport-metadata bytes per decoder-layer token
freeze the inherited matrix, restore the V15 plan, and execute the exact visible_matrix_sha256 lookup without creating an official namespace or quality marker
persist candidate manifests, exact-reproduction reports, codec/byte accounting, and dynamic_preflight before any quality marker
prove the inherited V13 quality matrix bytes and hashes are frozen before any V15 candidate output is generated
prove deterministic greedy re-execution reproduces every token ID and decoded output exactly without changing the frozen result

quality_execution.matrix_source: hash-bound V13 plan frozen_product_quality_matrix inherited unchanged through V14 and V15

required_quality_artifacts: predeclared_contract.json binding all source, model, tokenizer, plan, task, predecessor, matrix, helper, review, and environment hashes

failure_taxonomy.construction_or_codec_failure: preserve PRODUCT_PREFLIGHT_NO_GO with exact mismatch records; no quality execution
failure_taxonomy.dynamic_policy_failure: preserve PRODUCT_PREFLIGHT_NO_GO with named event evidence; no quality execution
failure_taxonomy.evaluator_no_execution: preserve EVALUATOR_NO_EXECUTION with null quality conclusion; do not classify RTL or numerical correctness
failure_taxonomy.quality_failure: preserve PRODUCT_QUALITY_NO_GO with all raw outputs and failed rubric dimensions
failure_taxonomy.quality_pass: preserve PRODUCT_QUALITY_READY and submit immutable evidence to a Fresh Reviewer; do not select the policy or advance the stage locally

prohibited_actions: modify RTL, verification references, sealed V10/V12/V13/V14 evidence, or consumed exactly-once evidence
resume, repair, replay, or write new evidence under the V13 or V14 namespaces
consume the V15 construction marker from a Planner cycle or create more than one V15 quality campaign
use exact BF16 token identity, BF16 response-gate identity, or the obsolete 4.036 cap as a V15 acceptance requirement
tune weights, metadata, prompts, generation settings, or rubric after observing V15 outputs
hide prompts, use a hidden harness, inspect a golden output, or omit raw failed outputs
claim accelerator completion from the quantized software reference
download or install a proprietary FPGA toolchain
completion_rule: The Engineer mission is complete only after immutable V15 construction/dynamic no-go evidence, evaluator-no-execution evidence, or one frozen product-quality campaign plus Fresh Reviewer submission. A quality pass is a specification-stage policy result only; selected_policy_id remains null and RTL/demo/U280 work remains locked until Fresh Review and Manager stage advance.
